scenario: An agent warning appears mid-cycle; decide whether to retrain early or adjust thresholds.
timeframe: Minutes to a decision, one cycle to confirm the impact.
baselineNote: Out of 10, in the manual world.

phases.name: Notice
phases.action: See three of four healthy and Root Cause Analysis flagged Warning.
phases.thought: Is this affecting operators right now?
painPoints: No way to tell a slow agent from a wrong one
phases.opportunity: Status, accuracy, latency and error rate on one card, with last-run freshness.
phases.momentLabel: A warning that explains itself rather than one that just alarms.

phases.name: Diagnose
phases.action: Confirm 1250ms and 2.30% on that agent; see that system sync is 45% of causes.
phases.thought: The warning is latency, and sync is what is breaking.
painPoints: Correlating cause and effect used to be manual
Three consoles and a good memory
phases.opportunity: An evidence trail from symptom to cause, in one place.

phases.name: Decide and act
phases.emotionLabel: Committing with the cost in view
phases.action: Review the projected +6–8% lift; trigger early retraining or move a threshold.
phases.thought: I can see the expected impact before I commit.
painPoints: No attribution from change to outcome
phases.opportunity: A forecast beside four retrains of history, a review-load projection beside the slider, and every change logged.
phases.momentLabel: A threshold change whose review-load trade-off is visible before commit.

traceability.signal: System Sync is the dominant root cause

traceability.painPoint: Threshold effects invisible until a cycle later
